content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DHS Tiruchirappalli Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://tiruchirappalli.nic.in/. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 04-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DHS Tiruchirappalli Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the DHS Tiruchirappalli Driver and Microbiologist posts is 04 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Driver and Microbiologist posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced by the District Health Society Tiruchirappalli for the Driver and Microbiologist positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Microbiologist post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Microbiologist post must possess an MSc in Medical Microbiology or MSc in Microbiology with at least 2 years of lab experience in diagnostic services for epidemic-prone diseases.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Driver post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Driver post in the DHS Tiruchirappalli Recruitment 2026 is 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Driver position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Driver (MMU driver) post will receive a salary of Rs.17,500/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the DHS Tiruchirappalli Recruitment 2026 primarily involves Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: The recruitment for Driver and Microbiologist posts by DHS Tiruchirappalli is for contractual positions.

faq.question: Q9. Which mode of application is accepted for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply through the offline mode for the DHS Tiruchirappalli Driver and Microbiologist recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the District Health Society Tiruchirappalli, which is https://tiruchirappalli.nic.in/.
